The <b>Crown Fragment</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The Crown Fragment must be delivered to [[Bone Bottom]] to complete the Grand Hunt Wish <i>The Terrible Tyrant</i>, available from its [[Wishwalls|Wishwall]] after obtaining the [[Cling Grip]]. It rewards a [[Heavy Rosary Necklace]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Flick the Fixer 01.png!Location in Bone Bottom
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Flick the Fixer 02.png!Flick the Fixer in Bone Bottom
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Crown Fragment is dropped after slaying the [[Skull Tyrant]] in the Marrow before Act 3. In Act 3, Bone Bottom is destroyed, so the Crown Fragment is not dropped.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Skull Tyrant 01.png!Location in the Marrow
|Image2 = Screenshot SS The Marrow 12.png!Skull Tyrant in the Marrow
}}

==Act 3==
The Crown Fragment will be removed from the inventory at the start of Act 3, as Bone Bottom has been destroyed.
